changes: Shopping uses separate menu-demand and manually-added groups within the existing layout; existing add, purchase and delete controls remain.
Reuse manual source and NULL week scope; no schema change or data rewrite.

Manual quantities, versions, purchased and outstanding amounts, source, identity and history survive plan changes, removal, refresh, other weeks and reopening the database, including same-ingredient manual and plan lines in exact and rough modes.
Assistant menu updates preserve manual purchase intent; demo rows use the manual quantity rather than matching plan figures.
limitations: Isolated SQLite and browser IPC tests. No live model, online two-device or overwrite installation test was performed.
